notes: Distributor page; page states the serial numbers shown are utilized with all Paloma brand systems and names Paloma as parent company. Rules transcribed from this page's own text only; no Rheem/Paloma page content imported. Styles 2, 4 and 5 state 'week and year' without splitting the digit group in text: WWYY split adopted because the YYWW reading fails the page's own examples (style 4 week 99 invalid, style 5 week 72 invalid) while WWYY decodes every page example validly, and the page lists week before year. Style 3 counting: character counting verified against the page example (digit-only counting gives week 91, invalid; bold group 2910 confirms week 29, year 10). Style 1: character and digit-only counting agree (no letter precedes the date digits). Page examples used verbatim; spaces in the style 2 example stripped by normalization.

Page: week = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits, year = 4th & 5th numerical digits, read as character positions (digit-only counting falsified: week 91 invalid). Bold group 2910 confirms week 29, year 10.
